Arohi joined our long-haul roster in January. I have watched how she handles the time changes and want to record it for new crew. She carries fruit and eats proper meals instead of living on snacks from the trolley. Last month she asked me to hold her answer on a transfer until she had slept, and she was right to. When tiredness and low mood did not lift, she booked a visit to the company doctor. What I did next: I asked Arohi to speak to the new crew on Friday.

passage: Sarita did night duty at the primary health centre in Barsana two weeks a month, and she had worked out rules.
